publication_scope: Selected historical evidence. Export performed offline; no device actions or network requests.
private_source_paths: Relative to the original private inspection directory. Originals remain excluded by /backups/ in .gitignore.

transformations.device.json: Explicit allowlist of build, tooling and access fields; identifiers and host paths omitted.
transformations.partitions.csv: Joined ADB by-name mappings with fastboot sizes and types by exact partition name; no GPT sectors, offsets or partition bytes inferred.
transformations.adb-excerpts.txt: Selected literal output with original source line numbers; no full raw probe export.
transformations.fastboot-excerpts.txt: Allowlisted bootloader keys and partition metadata; serial redacted; failed readback output retained.
transformations.recovery-update-excerpts.txt: Selected literal update lines with original source line numbers; unrelated properties/messages excluded.
transformations.ota-and-ohealth.json: Selected status fields, technical static findings and aggregate counts; raw phone messages/times/identifiers/keys omitted.
transformations.watchos-reference.json: Package identity and hash fields only; absolute source paths and binary archive excluded.

limitations: Source hashes identify private source files; those files are not distributed.
Public SHA256SUMS covers the exported evidence only and does not validate a firmware image or a full device backup.
The initial inspection and later fastboot/OTA probes occurred at different stages. Earlier no-reboot notes are not a whole-session claim.
